assignment.title: Continue the original twelve-minute saved-data feasibility scout after verified cloud startup. Inspect the same three CM-E1 changed-case manifests and at most twelve extra dataset/manifest files. Verify observation content, training/selection union, encoder origin, spool/layering, units and lineage. No prediction scoring, fitting, code edits, simulation experiment, collection or movement. Use the sourced scripts/cloud/env.sh environment before each build or worker shell. Preserve all original failed attempts. Write research.md, report.md, abstract.md and input hashes in the newly assigned session. The manager must establish the existing-login child workflow and retain or resolve the previous startup review obligation before dispatch.

explanations.explanation: Incomparable or overlapping folds conceal a usable prediction signal.
Measurement-model bias or weak identifiability can make prediction poorly track physical geometry even with fair folds.
